title: US midterms: Democrats win House and Senate from Republicans
summary: The Democratic Party gained control of the House and Senate, delivering a stinging rebuke to US President Donald Trump and his Republican Party. Follow DW's live updates.
byline: Elizabeth Schumacher, Richard Connor, Karl Sexton, Jenipher Camino Gonzalez, Wesley Dockery, Natalie Muller

blocks.text: IN DEPTH: What US midterm elections mean for Ukraine, Iran and elsewhere

While most foreign policy decisions ultimately rest with the executive branch, the outcome of the US midterms will have major repercussions for adversaries like Iran as well as countries like Ukraine, which rely on support from Washington.
Read our full report of how Tuesday's elections in the US will likely affect other nations here.
